destinations.name: Goa
destinations.shortDescription: Golden beaches, coconut palms, and vibrant nightlife
destinations.description: Goa is India's premier beach destination known for its Portuguese heritage, pristine beaches like Baga and Anjuna, water sports, seafood cuisine, and lively nightlife. Perfect for a relaxing beach getaway with a mix of adventure.

destinations.name: Rajasthan
destinations.shortDescription: Royal palaces, desert safaris, and colorful culture
destinations.description: Rajasthan is the land of kings and queens featuring magnificent forts and palaces. Explore the pink city of Jaipur, the golden city of Jaisalmer, and the blue city of Jodhpur. Experience camel safaris in the Thar Desert and immerse yourself in vibrant culture.

destinations.name: Kerala
destinations.shortDescription: Backwaters, spice plantations, and serene houseboat cruises
destinations.description: Known as 'God's Own Country', Kerala offers breathtaking backwaters, lush green tea and spice plantations, and tranquil houseboat cruises. Enjoy ayurvedic treatments, water sports, and pristine beaches with an ideal tropical climate.
destinations.bestTime: June to September, November to February

destinations.name: Himachal Pradesh
destinations.shortDescription: Snow-capped mountains, adventure sports, and hill stations
destinations.description: Experience the Himalayan beauty with hill stations like Shimla, Manali, and Kasol. Perfect for trekking, paragliding, skiing, and adventure seekers. Enjoy scenic mountain drives, ancient temples, and pristine nature.
destinations.bestTime: March to June, September to October

destinations.name: Taj Mahal - Agra
destinations.shortDescription: The monument of eternal love - UNESCO World Heritage Site
destinations.description: Visit the iconic Taj Mahal, one of the Seven Wonders of the World. Built by Emperor Shah Jahan for his beloved wife Mumtaz Mahal, this marble masterpiece is a testament to love and architecture. Also explore Agra Fort and Fatehpur Sikri.

destinations.name: Andaman & Nicobar Islands
destinations.shortDescription: Tropical paradise with azure waters and coral reefs
destinations.description: Experience pristine beaches, crystal-clear waters, and vibrant coral reefs. Perfect for snorkeling, diving, and water sports. Explore historical sites like Cellular Jail and relax on secluded islands.

destinations.name: Karnataka
destinations.shortDescription: Lush green hill stations, coffee plantations, and Western Ghats beauty
destinations.description: Karnataka is a treasure trove of natural beauty featuring stunning hill stations. Explore the misty hills of Coorg (Madikeri) with its coffee plantations and waterfalls, the scenic beauty of Chikmagalur, the adventurous trekking trails of Nandi Hills, and the serene beaches. Experience luxury stays, nature walks, and authentic local culture.

destinations.name: Mumbai
destinations.shortDescription: Mumbai (formerly called Bombay) is a densely populated city on India’s west coast. A financial center, it's India's largest city. On the Mumbai Harbour waterfront stands the iconic Gateway of India stone arch, built by the British Raj in 1924. Offshore, nearby Elephanta Island holds ancient cave temples dedicated to the Hindu god Shiva. The city's also famous as the heart of the Bollywood film industry.

packages.name: Goa Weekend Getaway
packages.title: Goa Weekend Getaway
packages.summary: 3 days, 2 nights – Beach paradise with water sports and nightlife
packages.details: Includes 3-star beachfront accommodation, daily breakfast, Dudhsagar waterfall tour, beach activities, and evening party passes.

packages.name: Rajasthan Heritage Tour
packages.title: Rajasthan Heritage Tour
packages.summary: 5 days, 4 nights – Explore magnificent forts and desert magic
packages.details: Visit Jaipur's City Palace and Hawa Mahal, camel safari in Jaisalmer, Mehrangarh Fort in Jodhpur. Includes heritage hotel stays, guided tours, and authentic Rajasthani cuisine.

packages.name: Kerala Backwater Cruise
packages.title: Kerala Backwater Cruise
packages.summary: 4 days, 3 nights – Houseboat adventure through tropical paradise
packages.details: Experience luxury houseboat cruise in Alleppey backwaters, visit spice plantations, enjoy Ayurvedic massage, and relax on pristine beaches. Authentic Kerala experience awaits.

packages.name: Andaman Island Paradise
packages.title: Andaman Island Paradise
packages.summary: 5 days, 4 nights – Snorkeling, diving, and island exploration
packages.details: Explore pristine beaches, coral reefs, and marine life. Visit Cellular Jail, enjoy water sports, scuba diving, and relax on secluded beaches. Tropical paradise at its best.

packages.name: North India Grand Tour
packages.title: North India Grand Tour
packages.summary: 8 days, 7 nights – Delhi, Agra, Jaipur triangle adventure
packages.details: Complete North India experience including Taj Mahal, City Palace, Jaipur bazaars, Delhi monuments. Luxury accommodations, guided tours, and exclusive dining experiences.

packages.name: Kerala Wellness Retreat
packages.title: Kerala Wellness Retreat
packages.summary: 7 days, 6 nights – Ayurveda, yoga, and complete rejuvenation
packages.details: Immerse yourself in traditional Ayurvedic treatments, daily yoga sessions, meditation, herbal therapies, and organic Keralan cuisine in a peaceful ashram setting.

packages.title: Karnataka Hill stations
packages.name: Karnataka Hill stations
packages.summary: Some popular hill stations in Karnataka include Coorg (also known as Madikeri), Chikmagalur, Nandi Hills, Agumbe, Kemmanagundi, and BR Hills

packages.title: Hyderabad
packages.name: Hyderabad
packages.details: Hyderabad is the capital of southern India's Telangana state. A major center for the technology industry, it's home to many upscale restaurants and shops. Its historic sites include Golconda Fort, a former diamond-trading center that was once the Qutb Shahi dynastic capital. The Charminar, a 16th-century mosque whose 4 arches support towering minarets, is an old city landmark near the long-standing Laad Bazaar.
